teaser: Keeping two ledgers at once: one for what gets said out loud, one for what gets noticed and held back. Life path 7 and ENFJ meet in that second ledger. The number asks for retreat, long stretches alone with a question until it resolves. The type is built for the opposite: a presence tuned to the room, reaching toward whoever is in it. Neither habit cancels the other here. The retreat sharpens what gets noticed later. The noticing makes the retreat hard to keep clean, because a face from last week keeps surfacing in it.
